# HIVE OSC protocol — version 2

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:osc` from shared/osc-schema.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Everything the HIVE backend sends over UDP, to every target enabled on the
dashboard (default `127.0.0.1:9000`; add your laptop's IP there). OSC 1.0,
one bundle per sample, big-endian, types `i` int32, `f` float32, `s` string.

Two shapes carry the same per-sample data. Use whichever suits your tool;
both are on by default and can be switched off on the dashboard.

## Identity

- **`uid`** — 8 characters, stable for a phone across reconnects and server
  restarts (derived from an id stored in the phone's browser). Use this when a
  *person* matters.
- **`slot`** — small integer 1..N, session-local, freed when a phone leaves
  and reused by the next joiner. Use this for `route 1 2 3`-style patching.

`/hive/join`, `/hive/leave` and the once-a-second `/hive/roster` map between them.

## `/hive/sample` — the wide message (18 arguments)

One per sensor sample per phone, ~60 Hz per phone. Type tags: `isffffffffffffffff`.

| # | field | type | unit | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `slot` | i | — | Session-local device number 1..N; freed when the phone leaves, reused by the next joiner. Convenient for route/select. |
| 2 | `uid` | s | — | Stable 8-character id of the phone; survives reconnects and server restarts. Use this when identity matters. |
| 3 | `t` | f | s | Seconds since the server started (float32 — enough resolution for a day). |
| 4 | `acc_x` | f | m/s² | Raw acceleration including gravity, x (phone right). Flat phone ≈ 0. |
| 5 | `acc_y` | f | m/s² | Raw acceleration including gravity, y (phone top). Flat phone ≈ 0. |
| 6 | `acc_z` | f | m/s² | Raw acceleration including gravity, z (out of the screen). Flat phone ≈ +9.81 on iOS and Android alike. |
| 7 | `rel_x` | f | m/s² | One-Euro-smoothed acceleration relative to the adaptive zero, x. Settles to 0 when the phone rests, at any angle. |
| 8 | `rel_y` | f | m/s² | Same, y. |
| 9 | `rel_z` | f | m/s² | Same, z. |
| 10 | `gyro_x` | f | °/s | Rotation rate about x (pitch). |
| 11 | `gyro_y` | f | °/s | Rotation rate about y (roll). |
| 12 | `gyro_z` | f | °/s | Rotation rate about z (yaw). |
| 13 | `activity` | f | 0..1 | How much the phone is turning or being jolted right now, smoothed (~0.25 s). 0 at rest. |
| 14 | `idle` | f | s | How long the phone has been at rest. 0 while active. |
| 15 | `acc_mag` | f | m/s² | |acc|. ≈ 9.81 when only gravity acts; deviates when shaken. |
| 16 | `rel_mag` | f | m/s² | |rel|. How far from the resting position, regardless of direction. |
| 17 | `gyro_mag` | f | °/s | |gyro|. How fast the phone turns, regardless of axis. |
| 18 | `turn` | f | °/s | Rotation about the vertical (gravity) axis, however the phone is held: turning around yourself. Positive = counter-clockwise seen from above. |

**Compatibility rule:** fields are only ever appended. New server-side
features (there will be more — everything is computed here, phones send raw
sensors only) arrive as new columns at the end; `/hive/schema` carries the
version. A patch that unpacks the first 18 keeps working.

Axes: x = phone's right, y = phone's top, z = out of the screen. Raw
acceleration includes gravity and is sign-normalized so a flat, screen-up
phone reads `acc_z ≈ +9.81` on iOS and Android alike. People can flip
individual axes on their phone if the direction feels wrong to them.

### Processed signals

- **rel** — acceleration smoothed with a *One-Euro filter* and taken relative
  to an *adaptive zero*. The One-Euro filter (Casiez et al. 2012) is a low-pass
  whose cutoff rises with the speed of change: at rest it sits at
  `filter: min cutoff` (dashboard, default 1 Hz) and the jitter is gone; the
  faster the signal moves, the higher the cutoff (`filter: beta`, default
  0.3 per m/s² per s), so quick gestures arrive without lag. The zero: once a
  phone has been at rest for `zero: rest before` seconds (default 1.2 s) it
  slides toward the resting value with time constant `zero: slide time`
  (default 2.5 s). So `rel` is 0 whenever someone holds still — at any
  angle — and only *change* produces signal.
- **activity** — max of turning rate / 150 °/s and acceleration change / 6
  m/s², smoothed ~250 ms, clamped 0..1.
- **idle** — seconds since activity last dropped below 0.06.
- **turn** (v2) — the gyroscope projected onto the smoothed gravity direction:
  the rotation rate about the room's vertical, whether the phone lies flat
  (then it equals `gyro_z`), stands in a pocket, or is held at an angle.
  Turning on the spot is the same signal for everyone.

## `/hive/swarm` — the whole swarm (5 arguments)

At the swarm rate (dashboard, default 30 Hz). Type tags: `fifff`.

| # | field | type | unit | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `t` | f | s | Seconds since the server started. |
| 2 | `count` | i | — | Phones currently streaming. |
| 3 | `energy` | f | m/s² | Mean |acc − g| over phones: how hard the swarm moves. |
| 4 | `motion` | f | °/s | Mean |gyro| over phones: how much it turns. |
| 5 | `sync` | f | 0..1 | 1 when all phones turn equally hard, → 0 when one moves and the rest are still. |

## Events and housekeeping

| address | arguments | when | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/hive/join` | i slot · s uid · s name · s platform | a phone joins | platform is ios, android, other (fake phones) or unknown. name may be empty. |
| `/hive/leave` | i slot · s uid | a phone leaves | Sent on an explicit leave or after the device timeout. |
| `/hive/roster` | i count · (i slot · s uid · s name)… | every second | Everyone currently in the swarm, so a receiver started late still learns the names. |
| `/hive/schema` | i version | every second | Protocol version, currently 2. Wide messages only append fields between versions. |
| `/hive/ping` | i n | dashboard Ping | For checking that a target receives anything at all. |

## Per-field messages

Same data as `/hive/sample`, one small message per quantity, addressed by slot.

| address | arguments | when | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/hive/dev/<slot>/acc` | f x · f y · f z | every sample | Raw acceleration, gravity included. |
| `/hive/dev/<slot>/rel` | f x · f y · f z | every sample | Relative to the adaptive zero. |
| `/hive/dev/<slot>/gyro` | f x · f y · f z | every sample | Rotation rate. |
| `/hive/dev/<slot>/activity` | f a | every sample | 0..1. |
| `/hive/dev/<slot>/mag` | f |acc| · f |rel| · f |gyro| | every sample | Magnitudes. |
| `/hive/dev/<slot>/turn` | f turn | every sample | Rotation about the vertical, °/s (v2). |
| `/hive/dev/<slot>/join` | s platform · i slot | join | Slot-addressed twin of /hive/join. |
| `/hive/dev/<slot>/leave` | i slot | leave | Slot-addressed twin of /hive/leave. |
| `/hive/swarm/count` | i | swarm rate | Twin of the count field. |
| `/hive/swarm/energy` | f | swarm rate | Twin of the energy field. |
| `/hive/swarm/motion` | f | swarm rate | Twin of the motion field. |
| `/hive/swarm/sync` | f | swarm rate | Twin of the sync field. |

## Receiving

**Pure Data** (vanilla ≥ 0.46) — `examples/hive-receive.pd`:

```
[netreceive -u -b 9000] → [oscparse] → [list trim] → [route hive] → [route sample swarm join leave roster]
  sample → [unpack f s f f f f f f f f f f f f f f f]   (slot uid t acc_x acc_y acc_z rel_x rel_y rel_z gyro_x gyro_y gyro_z activity idle acc_mag rel_mag gyro_mag turn)
```
oscparse turns `s` into symbols and `i`/`f` into floats.

**Max/MSP:** `[udpreceive 9000]` → `[route /hive/sample]` → `[unpack i s f f f …]`.

**SuperCollider:** `thisProcess.openUDPPort(9000); OSCdef(\\hive, { |msg| msg.postln }, '/hive/sample');`

**Python:** `python3 examples/osc_listen.py 9000` prints everything (no dependencies), or
skip OSC and read JSON from `ws://<mac>:8080/feed` with `examples/feed_client.py`.

Press **Ping** next to your target on the dashboard: `/hive/ping` arrives if the route works.
